Myth: Pehle 5 video par views kam, matlab channel fail.
Fact: Shuruaat mein sab seekhte hain. Har video se kuch sudhaar sakte ho.
👉 Title dekho
👉 Thumbnail dekho
👉 Pehle 30 second dekho
